create_embedding: create an nn.Embedding module with num_embeddings, embedding_dim, and optional padding_idx for word embeddings
create_embedding_from_pretrained: create an nn.Embedding from pretrained weights tensor with optional freeze and padding_idx
create_embedding_bag: create an nn.EmbeddingBag module with mode sum, mean, or max for efficient bag-of-embeddings reduction
create_embedding_bag_from_pretrained: create an nn.EmbeddingBag from pretrained weights tensor with optional freeze and mode
test_embedding_forward: test the nn.Embedding forward pass by passing index tensors and verifying output embedding shapes
